{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final check: ensure we filtered correctly and handled data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Re-apply filter for LOYAL and completed
loyal_completed = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Convert revenue
loyal_completed['revenue_float'] = loyal_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm no QA orders (should be 0)
qa_orders = (loyal_completed['revenue_float'] == 999999.99).sum()
assert qa_orders == 0, f"Found {qa_orders} QA orders in the filtered data, which should not happen."

# Confirm no refunded orders
assert (loyal_completed['status'] == 'completed').all(), "Some filtered rows are not 'completed'"

# Confirm all are loyal
assert (loyal_completed['customer_segment'] == 'loyal').all(), "Some filtered rows are not 'loyal'"

# Final mean
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f"Final mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
